monthly.note: 本月(2026 年 9 月)發佈的項目不足 5 個，已用最近期(近 30–60 天)的項目補足。
monthly.note_en: Less than 5 items were released this month (September 2026), so the list has been supplemented with recent releases (within the last 30–60 days).

items.name: Meshy
items.why: Meshy 7 提升了 AI 3D 生成、8K 紋理和自動綁骨功能，特別增加了四足動物綁骨支援，強化了從模型到動畫的流程。
items.why_en: Meshy 7 enhances AI 3D generation, 8K texturing, and auto-rigging capabilities, notably adding quadruped rigging support, streamlining the model-to-animation pipeline.

items.name: Autodesk Flow Studio 3D Editor + Canvas
items.version: 3D Editor + Canvas (2026 年 9 月更新)
items.why: 此重大更新為 AI 生成角色提供 3D 場景控制，並改進了面部動畫和資產管理，直接影響綁骨後的動畫流程。
items.why_en: This major update provides 3D scene control for AI-generated characters, with improved facial animation and asset management, directly impacting post-rigging animation workflows.

items.name: Cascadeur
items.why: 此版本新增動畫圖層、AI 中間影格和動作生成，並改進了綁骨與姿勢工具，提升了 AI 輔助動畫的效率。
items.why_en: This version adds animation layers, AI inbetweening, and motion generation, enhancing rigging and posing tools and improving the efficiency of AI-assisted animation.

items.name: Armature
items.why: 一款新發布的免費 AI 輔助獨立綁骨和蒙皮工具，支援多種模型格式和預設骨架，為獨立開發者提供便利。
items.why_en: A newly released free AI-assisted standalone character rigging and skinning tool, supporting various model formats and preset skeletons, offering convenience for indie developers.

items.name: Smooth Weights
items.why: Maya 綁骨外掛的重大更新，核心重寫以提升蒙皮權重平滑處理速度，對於精細綁骨工作至關重要。
items.why_en: A significant update to this Maya rigging add-on, with its core rewritten for faster skin weight smoothing, crucial for detailed rigging work.

monthly.note: 本月新發佈不足 5 個，故以最近期 (2026 年 8 月) 的發佈補足。Pika 的音訊模型於 2026 年 8 月 18 日發佈。
monthly.note_en: Fewer than 5 new releases this month, so the list is supplemented with recent releases (August 2026). Pika's audio models were released on August 18, 2026.

items.name: Suno v6 / v6-wild / v6-mini
items.why: Suno 發佈了全新的 v6 系列模型，採用授權數據訓練，並提供更精細的編輯控制，顯著提升了 AI 音樂生成的能力。
items.why_en: Suno released its new v6 model family, trained on licensed data, offering more refined editing controls and significantly advancing AI music generation capabilities.

items.name: Aunio
items.why: FineVoice 推出 Aunio，這是一個端到端的 AI 音訊製作代理，整合了語音、配音、音樂、音效和音訊處理，提供全面的音訊創作工作流程。
items.why_en: FineVoice launched Aunio, an end-to-end AI audio production agent that integrates voice, voiceovers, music, sound effects, and audio processing, offering a comprehensive audio creation workflow.

items.name: Generative Media Tools (Premiere Pro 音效生成)
items.why: Adobe Premiere Pro 更新，將 AI 驅動的音效生成功能直接整合到編輯時間軸中，大幅簡化了專業影片製作中的音效創作流程。
items.why_en: Adobe Premiere Pro updated to integrate AI-powered sound effect generation directly into the editing timeline, significantly streamlining sound creation in professional video production.

items.name: ElevenLabs Music v2.5 API Support
items.why: ElevenLabs 為其音樂生成功能提供了 Music v2.5 API 支援，為開發者帶來了更強大和靈活的音樂創作能力。
items.why_en: ElevenLabs introduced Music v2.5 API support for its music generation capabilities, providing developers with more powerful and flexible tools for music creation.

items.name: Pika Soundtrack / Music / SFX
items.why: Pika 推出了一套新的音訊生成模型，包括用於影片配樂、音樂創作和音效生成的工具，擴展了其在 AI 媒體領域的產品線。
items.why_en: Pika launched a new suite of audio generation models, including tools for video soundtracks, music creation, and sound effects, expanding its offerings in the AI media space.
